snippet.title: DNA NEMESIS Reveal Trailer - Future Games Show at gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5095800/DNA_NEMESIS/
A world premiere trailer revealed DNA Nemesis, a sci-fi third-person shooter with animal-headed protagonists. It's coming to PC in December 2026.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
